Heads-up from captain (QA): the file content/grammar/prefer-would-rather-had-better.json currently fails JSON parsing, so the full-repo validator exits 1 for everyone:

  content/grammar/prefer-would-rather-had-better.json: invalid JSON — Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 3555 (line 48 column 196)

Please re-check that file when you continue: parse it with `node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('content/grammar/prefer-would-rather-had-better.json','utf8'))"` and fix the stray quote/comma (position 3555 is likely an unescaped double quote inside a string, or a trailing comma). Then run `node scripts/validate-content.mjs --only content/grammar/prefer-would-rather` to confirm.

Also FYI: content/plan.json (which I just wrote) references `defining-relative-clauses` and `non-defining-relative-clauses` — those are yours and not on disk yet, so the plan cross-check will keep failing until they land. No action needed if they are already in progress; just don't drop them.
